latestVersion.changelog:
Best Image Creator 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Generate high-quality AI images from short text prompts in about 20-40 seconds.
- Simple workflow: connect, prompt, generate, and download—no complex export or timeline settings needed.
- Free trial available with a temporary token; full 1080p MP4 exports supported.
- Detects user requests for export, credits, status, and uploads; routes actions accordingly.
- Supports multiple media formats including mp4, jpg, png, gif, and more.
- Provides clear user feedback for connection status, errors, and in-progress tasks.
